name: Malfeasance

frame.name: Explosive Shadow
frame.description: Shoot tainted slugs that burrow into combatants. Stacking enough slugs causes them all to explode, stunning surviving combatants. Strong against  [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.description:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.description:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Taken Predator
perks.description: Bonus damage against Taken enemies and Gambit invaders.

perks.name: Heavy Grip
perks.description:
This grip is weighted for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Decreases handling speed

flavor: "Nothing kills a Guardian faster than another Guardian." —The Drifter

catalyst.name: Malfeasance Catalyst
catalyst.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.
